<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_LANParty" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/lan-party">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_LANParty">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Organizer" name="Organizer" processRef="Process_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_LANParty" name="LAN Party" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Planning" name="Planning started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToInvitations</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SendInvitations" name="Send invitations to 10 friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToInvitations</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvitationsToFindGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FindGames" name="Find out which games they want to play">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvitationsToFindGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FindGamesToListReceived</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_GamesListReceived" name="List of games received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FindGamesToListReceived</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ListReceivedToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Planning_Split" name="Plan date and check games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ListReceivedToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToDateMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCheckGames</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateMerge" name="Date to be appointed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToDateMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnotherDateToDateMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointDate" name="Appoint a date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AppointDateToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DateAgreed" name="8 or more people agree?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AppointDateToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateAgreedToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DateNotAgreedToAnotherDate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AppointAnotherDate" name="Appoint another date">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateNotAgreedToAnotherDate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnotherDateToDateMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckGames" name="Check if all desired games are available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCheckGames</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckGamesToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMissing" name="Games missing?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckGamesToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMissingToDownload</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DownloadGames" name="Download missing games">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMissingToDownload</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_GamesMerge" name="Games checked">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_GamesMergeToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Planning_Join" name="Date agreed and games ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DateAgreedToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_GamesMergeToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToDetermineBeer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DetermineBeer" name="Determine how much beer is required">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToDetermineBeer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DetermineBeerToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerEnough" name="Enough beer?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DetermineBeerToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuyBeer" name="Buy missing beer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BuyToBeerMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_BeerMerge" name="Beer ready">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BuyToBeerMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_EnjoyLANParty" name="Enjoy the LAN party">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnjoyToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_LANParty" name="LAN party enjoyed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnjoyToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToInvitations" sourceRef="StartEvent_Planning" targetRef="Task_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvitationsToFindGames" sourceRef="Task_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_FindGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FindGamesToListReceived" sourceRef="Task_FindGames" targetRef="Event_GamesListReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ListReceivedToSplit" sourceRef="Event_GamesListReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Planning_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToDateMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_Planning_Split" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCheckGames" sourceRef="Gateway_Planning_Split" targetRef="Task_CheckGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateMergeToAppointDate" sourceRef="Gateway_DateMerge" targetRef="Task_AppointDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AppointDateToDecision" sourceRef="Task_AppointDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateAgreed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateAgreedToJoin" name="8 or more agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreed" targetRef="Gateway_Planning_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DateNotAgreedToAnotherDate" name="Fewer than 8 agree" sourceRef="Gateway_DateAgreed" targetRef="Task_AppointAnotherDate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnotherDateToDateMerge" sourceRef="Task_AppointAnotherDate" targetRef="Gateway_DateMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckGamesToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CheckGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMissing"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMissingToDownload" name="Some missing" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Task_DownloadGames"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesCompleteToMerge" name="All available" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMissing" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DownloadToGamesMerge" sourceRef="Task_DownloadGames" targetRef="Gateway_GamesMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_GamesMergeToJoin" sourceRef="Gateway_GamesMerge" targetRef="Gateway_Planning_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToDetermineBeer" sourceRef="Gateway_Planning_Join" targetRef="Task_DetermineBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetermineBeerToDecision" sourceRef="Task_DetermineBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerEnough"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerNotEnoughToBuy" name="Not enough" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Task_BuyBeer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerEnoughToMerge" name="Enough" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerEnough" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BuyToBeerMerge" sourceRef="Task_BuyBeer" targetRef="Gateway_BeerMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BeerMergeToEnjoy" sourceRef="Gateway_BeerMerge" targetRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnjoyToEnd" sourceRef="Task_EnjoyLANParty" targetRef="EndEvent_LANParty"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
